scripts.dev: set -a && source .env && set +a; PORT_TO_KILL=${PORT:-3003}; lsof -ti:$PORT_TO_KILL | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null && echo "[dev] Killed process on port $PORT_TO_KILL" || true; echo "[dev] Using .env"; npm run dev --workspace apps/web
scripts.start: set -a && source .env.prod && set +a; PORT_TO_KILL=${PORT:-3003}; lsof -ti:$PORT_TO_KILL | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null && echo "[start] Killed process on port $PORT_TO_KILL" || true; echo "[start] Using .env.prod"; APP_ENV=prod npm run start --workspace apps/web
scripts.api: set -a && source .env && set +a; git config user.email "edharmarao@gmail.com" && git config user.name "edharmarao"; PORT_TO_KILL=${API_PORT:-8003}; lsof -ti:$PORT_TO_KILL | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null && echo "[api] Killed process on port $PORT_TO_KILL" || true; echo "[api] Using .env"; cd apps/api && .venv/bin/uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port $PORT_TO_KILL
scripts.api:prod: APP_ENV=prod set -a && source .env.prod && set +a; git config user.email "edharmarao@gmail.com" && git config user.name "edharmarao"; PORT_TO_KILL=${API_PORT:-8003}; lsof -ti:$PORT_TO_KILL | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null && echo "[api:prod] Killed process on port $PORT_TO_KILL" || true; echo "[api:prod] Using .env.prod"; cd apps/api && APP_ENV=prod .venv/bin/uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port $PORT_TO_KILL
